description: This Java class 'LogWrapper' serves as a wrapper around Android's native Log utility, implementing the LogNode interface. It allows logging messages to pass through a chain of LogNode objects, with this class acting as the initial point that delegates to the Android Log system and forwards log data to the next node if configured.

classes.name: LogWrapper
classes.description: A helper class that wraps Android's native Log utility, implementing the LogNode interface and enabling log message chaining.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the linked list for chaining logs.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain to receive log data after this one.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Logs a message with a specified priority, tag, optional Throwable, and forwards it to the next node.
